packageRules.description: Pin every container image to a digest. Tags stay in the ref for readability; the digest is what actually gets pulled.
The bootc base is deliberately unpinned. Fedora ships security updates into the :44 tag and the weekly rebuild is how this node gets them; a digest pin would freeze the OS until Renovate opened a PR.

Bundle every non-major update into one weekly PR, so each week costs a single merge and a single signed empty commit. digest/pinDigest are listed explicitly because the stock group:allNonMajor preset omits them, which would leave the tag-less images (grafana, prometheus, cloudflared, actual, siyuan) as separate PRs.

Majors get their own PRs so one breaking release cannot hold the weekly bundle hostage. immich-server and immich-machine-learning still travel together: they share a version and will not talk to each other across a mismatch. Non-major immich updates already land together in the bundle above.
